value.rationale: Nonconstant bounded directional mortality and the arctan/logistic examples are explicitly motivated in the 2026 source and its threshold behavior is not established there. This theorem distinguishes a complete failure of infinite localized equilibrium from positive finite-model equilibria of nonzero limiting total mass, quantifies their escape, and clarifies when numerical finite cutoffs cannot represent a genuine stationary distribution. The result is structural across all bounded profiles meeting a natural unattained-limit condition and is not an arbitrary parameter slice, table recomputation, or purely finite observation.
